name: Legendary Heroes
label: Quest
description: Legendary Heroes: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Your radiate command and power, adventurer. Exalted in the eyes of Frostwolf - the enemy cowers at the mention of your name.
Rise, Hero of Frostwolf. Rise and be honored!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Soon, all on the field of battle will be under your watchful eye. Command of the Valley and its troops will be yours!
